Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.localization.vision

Class PhotonVisionCameraIO

java.lang.Object
frc.lib.NinjasLib.localization.vision.PhotonVisionCameraIO
All Implemented Interfaces:
VisionCameraIO
Direct Known Subclasses:
PhotonVisionSimCameraIO
public class PhotonVisionCameraIO extends Object implements VisionCameraIO
VisionCameraIO implementation for a real, physically-connected PhotonVision camera. Wraps a PhotonCamera/PhotonPoseEstimator pair to turn unread pipeline results into multi-tag VisionOutput pose estimates, and tolerates the camera disconnecting. For a simulated PhotonVision camera, see the subclass PhotonVisionSimCameraIO.

  • Constructor Details

    • PhotonVisionCameraIO

      public PhotonVisionCameraIO(String name, edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Transform3d cameraPose, VisionConstants constants)
      Creates a PhotonVision camera IO and builds its PhotonPoseEstimator from the current field layout (via constants.fieldLayoutGetter).
      Parameters:
      name - name of the camera, matching its name in the PhotonVision UI/coprocessor
      cameraPose - location of the camera on the robot (from center, positive x forward, positive y left, and positive angle is counterclockwise)
      constants - shared vision configuration, used to obtain the AprilTag field layout

  • Method Details

    • update

      public VisionOutput[] update()
      Drains all unread pipeline results from the camera and turns each one into a VisionOutput carrying a multi-tag pose estimate (via PhotonPoseEstimator.estimateCoprocMultiTagPose) plus the per-target data used to populate Vision's target-distance/ambiguity accessors. This is the method Vision.periodic() calls each loop to pull fresh data from this camera.

      If reading from the camera throws (e.g. it is unplugged), the camera is marked disconnected and every subsequent call returns an empty array until the object is recreated.

      Specified by:
      update in interface VisionCameraIO
      Returns:
      one VisionOutput per unread pipeline result, or an empty array if there were no new results or the camera is disconnected
